capabilities: Show notes as Today, Week, Projects, Backlog & Waiting and Guide boards over Bases
Drag cards between columns or onto Week days to rewrite the underlying note
Tick tasks, set states, set deadlines and plan tasks for a day or week
Rearrange a board's order, saved in its dashboard note
Check the Tasks plugin setup via the Guide's Setup tile
extras: Keeps no data of its own and uses no network; every change is a small edit to a note. Not marked desktop-only but the phone app has untested. Part of a wider 'Second Brain' framework with its own setup plugin and design docs.
intentEvidence: Adds five views to Bases, Obsidian's core plugin for views over notes. Bases picks the notes, and Ninja Board draws them.
problem: Obsidian's Bases core plugin picks notes but offers no interactive board views for people who keep tasks, projects and appointments as plain notes.

relations.evidence: task lines in the Tasks plugin's Dataview format
Adds five views to Bases, Obsidian's core plugin for views over notes.
Second Brain Setup builds the vault with Tasks already set up and the five dashboards in place.

requires.name: Tasks community plugin (Dataview format, custom Waiting status)

summary: Board views — Today, Week, Projects, Backlog & Waiting, Guide — that draw your notes' tasks and projects as draggable cards on top of Bases.
